content:
I noticed a trivial error on the Lean web site: in the demo proof on the home page, the line

/-- A prime is a number larger than 1 with no trivial divisors -/

should of course be

/-- A prime is a number larger than 1 with no non-trivial divisors -/

I'm not sure where to report this. I looked at Lean's GitHub page to try to find a repository corresponding to the web site where I could find an issue, but couldn't find one (I searched for repos including "web" in their name). Where should feedback of this nature go?
This topic was moved here from #general > where to report an error on the Lean web site? by Kevin Buzzard.
I'm going to guess "report this here". This is on the "Mathematics" tab in the code box right at the top of the lean-lang website.
That error was on me, thanks for spotting!
Thanks Adam and Kevin. A more official place to post would be #general > Discussion: New lean-lang.org, or you could reach out to me.
